propositions: Retire the allowlist-based grandfathering escape hatch and enforce 800 LOC as an absolute cap with no exemptions for any src/rebar/**/*.py file (excluding __pycache__).

Lock the limit to 800 by reading it from a single-source file (.github/module-size-limit.txt) and preventing changes except via admin force-submit by detecting if the base limit differs and failing with a 'must override' error.

Rewrite the module-size gate in both gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml to fetch main's tip by explicit GitHub URL (not origin remote) using git cat-file -e refs/remotes/gh-main to distinguish bootstrap from limit changes, and warn on fetch failure rather than silently falling through.

Update test_module_size_contract.py to read the cap from the limit file and assert no src/rebar file exceeds it, and update test_ci_workflow_parity.py to reference the new limit file instead of allowlist/ceilings.
Keep the now-empty allowlist and ceilings files in this change so main's current gate remains green on CI; Phase 2b will delete them once the new gate is live.
The gate must fail with a 'must not be removed' error if the limit file is absent, enforcing the missing-file guard.
